title: IslamicMMLU: A Benchmark for Evaluating LLMs on Islamic Knowledge

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLMs on 800 multiple-choice questions regarding Islamic jurisprudence (Fiqh) where each option is a correct ruling according to one of the four major Sunni schools of thought (Hanafi, Maliki, Shafi'i, Hanbali). Bias is measured by tracking the selection distribution across the schools and using a chi-squared test to identify significant systematic deviations from a uniform 25% selection rate.
